Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.backup

Class BackupEngine

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.backup.BackupEngine
public final class BackupEngine extends Object
The AWT-free backup/restore engine. It writes and reads standard ZIP archives with the JDK's built-in java.util.zip (no third-party dependency), so an archive produced here opens in any unzip tool and vice-versa.

Reliability. A backup streams into a sibling .part file and is atomically moved onto the target only after the whole archive is written, so an interrupted run never leaves a truncated .zip behind. Unreadable files are skipped with a warning rather than aborting the run.

Security. Restore is hardened against the Zip Slip vulnerability: every entry is resolved against the destination and rejected if it escapes it (absolute names, ../ traversal or a symlinked escape), so a hostile archive cannot overwrite files outside the chosen folder.

Entry names are relative to each source's parent, preserving the folder structure. Long-running loops honour an optional BooleanSupplier cancel signal so the UI can abort a job.
